about: Refactor 17, Stage B: the public files of the area kitchen (the lines of contracts in scripts/layers.json) are the workspace package @purin-labs/area-kitchen-contract in areas/kitchen/contract, the contract of the area. The owner decided on 2026-11-24 that a contract imports only the foundation, outside packages and the contract of another area, and scripts/check-layers.mjs holds that rule. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. moduleFrom: the public files of areas/kitchen that another area imports, and the public files that they import, belong to the plan, and --sync-plan adds each one; stays names each other public file, which stays public in the area (the scope that the owner approved on 2026-11-24). files: a Worker file goes to server/ and a Portal file to ui/, with its sub-path below server/ or ui/ of the area, less a folder contract/ (sourcePrefixes; movedFolders names each public folder that moves whole under another last name). package: the exports map gives each .ts file of server/ and of ui/, each style sheet of ui/, and each .tsx file, which another module imports; the dependencies are the packages that the files import. package.typeCheck false: the files read Env keys that the Actor files of the Worker merge, as the area package does; the Worker program and the Portal program check each file. edits: the source roots of the lints read the folders of the package.

edits.why: the lints of the Worker source and ESLint read the Worker files of the contract package
the Portal lints and the ESLint rules of the Portal source read the Portal files of the contract package
